content.study:
Section 26 — Expert appointed by arbitral tribunal

Section 26 permits the tribunal, unless the parties agree otherwise, to appoint one or more experts to report on specific issues. The expert may be required to participate in an oral hearing for examination, and the tribunal may require parties to provide necessary information, documents or goods for the expert's work.

The provision must be applied by identifying its operative conditions, the procedural stage and its connected sections. Statutory exceptions and party agreements must be kept distinct from the default rule.
